mapper.select:
select no, title, writer, writedate, hit
from ( select rownum rnum, no, title, writer, writedate, hit from ( select no, title, writer, writedate, hit from board order by no desc ) ) where rnum between #{startRow} and #{endRow}
mapper.update: update board set hit = hit+1 where no = #{no}
mapper.insert:
select board_seq.nextval from dual
insert into board(no, title, content, writer, pw) values (#{no}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{pw})
